name: Big Sky Country
source:
A recently unemployed individual must bring two feuding families together to save their land from a shady businessman.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Big_Sky_Country]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一名刚刚失业的人必须让两个互相敌视的家族携手合作，从一名不择手段的商人手中保住他们的土地。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Big_Sky_Country]Choices Wikia[/url]]
